final: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT City AS city, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM Employee GROUP BY City), totals AS (SELECT SUM(employee_count) AS total_count FROM city_counts), paired AS (SELECT c.city, c.employee_count, 1.0 * c.employee_count / t.total_count AS share FROM city_counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), averages AS (SELECT AVG(employee_count) AS average_count FROM paired) SELECT p.city, p.employee_count, p.share, 1.0 * p.employee_count / a.average_count AS count_divided_by_average FROM paired AS p CROSS JOIN averages AS a WHERE a.average_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.city
